entries.title: ___ the need to be touched to open or close, automatic doors are essential…
entries.text: ___ the need to be touched to open or close, automatic doors are essential… [A] Through 通过 [B] Despite 尽管 [C] Besides 此外 [D] Without 不需要 答案 D Without ___ the need to be touched to open or close, automatic doors are essential…___需要触摸才能打开或关闭，自动门是必不可少的…… [A] Through 通过 [B] Despite 尽管 [C] Besides 此外 [D] Without 不需要 💡 考场思路看到 automatic doors 这个词，第一反应是"自动=不用手碰"。空格后 the need to be touched（被触碰的需求），自动门之所以叫自动门，就是因为它"不需要"被触碰。这是对自动门基本定义的考查。 逐项排除 [A] Through the need…"通过需要被触碰"——语义不通，自动门不是通过触碰来工作的； [B] Despite the need…"尽管需要被触碰"——这与自动门特性完全相反； [C] Besides the need…"除了需要被触碰之外还……"——暗示自动门也需要触碰，错； [D] Without the need…"不需要被触碰"——完美对应 automatic 的定义。 语法点睛逗号前面是介词短语作状语，主句是 automatic doors are essential…。Without 引导的介词短语表"没有……的情况下"，是完形常考的逻辑开头。

entries.title: The Romans buried the nails probably for the sake of ___.
entries.text: The Romans buried the nails probably for the sake of ___. [A] saving them for future use 将它们保存以备将来使用 [B] keeping them from rusting 防止它们生锈 [C] letting them grow in value 让它们增值 [D] hiding them from the locals 答案 D The Romans buried the nails probably for the sake of ___.罗马人埋钉子可能是为了___。 [A] saving them for future use将它们保存以备将来使用 [B] keeping them from rusting防止它们生锈 [C] letting them grow in value让它们增值 [D] hiding them from the locals 💡 考场思路题干 Romans buried the nails 定位第二段。关键句："they didn't want the local Caledonians getting their hands on 10 tons of weapon-grade iron"——不想让当地人拿到武器级铁。get their hands on = 得到。 逐项分析 [A] 留着以后用 → 原文说撤退匆忙，不是存起来； [B] 防止生锈 → 无中生有； [C] 让它们升值 → 无中生有； [D] 藏起来不让当地人拿到 → 正确，对应 didn't want...getting their hands on。 核心词汇 weapon-grade adj. 武器级的 hoard n. 窖藏 withdrawal n. 撤退 millennia n. 千年（复数） get one's hands on 弄到手 rushed adj. 匆忙的

entries.title: The example of early 17th-century Virginians is used to ___.
entries.text: The example of early 17th-century Virginians is used to ___. [A] highlight the thriftiness of early American colonists 凸显早期美洲殖民者的节俭 [B] illustrate the high status of blacksmiths in that period 展现那一时期铁匠的崇高地位 [C] contrast the attitudes of different civilisations towards nails 对比不同文明对钉子的态度 [D] show the preciousness of nail-making technology at that time 答案 D The example of early 17th-century Virginians is used to ___.17世纪初弗吉尼亚人的例子被用来___。 [A] highlight the thriftiness of early American colonists凸显早期美洲殖民者的节俭 [B] illustrate the high status of blacksmiths in that period展现那一时期铁匠的崇高地位 [C] contrast the attitudes of different civilisations towards nails对比不同文明对钉子的态度 [D] show the preciousness of nail-making technology at that time 💡 考场思路例证题答案=例子前后的论点句。例子后一句："burn down an entire house just to reclaim the nails underlines how scarce, costly and valuable the simple-seeming technology was"——烧掉房子只为回收钉子，说明制钉技术有多宝贵。 逐项分析 [A] 夸殖民者节俭 → 例子不是为了夸节俭； [B] 说铁匠地位高 → 过度推断； [C] 对比不同文明态度 → 只有一个例子，没有对比； [D] 说明制钉技术珍贵 → 正确，scarce, costly, valuable = preciousness。 题型铁律例证题（be used to / is mentioned to）答案永远不在例子本身，而在例子前后的论点句。

entries.title: What played the major role in lowering the price of nails after the late 1700s?
entries.text: What played the major role in lowering the price of nails after the late 1700s? [A] Increased productivity. [B] Wider use of new energies. 新能源的更广泛应用。 [C] Fiercer market competition. 更激烈的市场竞争。 [D] Reduced cost of raw materials. 原材料成本降低。 答案 A What played the major role in lowering the price of nails after the late 1700s?在19世纪后期之后，什么在降低指甲价格方面发挥了主要作用？ [A] Increased productivity. [B] Wider use of new energies.新能源的更广泛应用。 [C] Fiercer market competition.更激烈的市场竞争。 [D] Reduced cost of raw materials.原材料成本降低。 💡 考场思路定位第四段。原文："most of the credit goes to nail manufacturers who simply found more efficient ways to turn steel into nails"——主要功劳在于更高效的生产方法。more efficient ways = increased productivity。 逐项分析 [A] 生产率提高 → 正确； [B] 新能源 → 原文 cheaper energy 只是 partly； [C] 市场竞争 → 未提及； [D] 原材料降价 → cheaper iron 也只是 partly，不是 major role。

entries.title: It can be learned from Paragraph 5 that nails ___.
entries.text: It can be learned from Paragraph 5 that nails ___. [A] have undergone many technological improvements 经历了诸多技术改进 [B] have remained basically the same since Roman times [C] are less studied than other everyday products 比其他日常用品研究得少 [D] are one of the world's most significant inventions 是世界上最重要的发明之一 答案 B It can be learned from Paragraph 5 that nails ___.从第5段可以了解到，钉子___。 [A] have undergone many technological improvements经历了诸多技术改进 [B] have remained basically the same since Roman times [C] are less studied than other everyday products比其他日常用品研究得少 [D] are one of the world's most significant inventions是世界上最重要的发明之一 💡 考场思路第五段："Roman nails are still clearly nails"——罗马钉子至今还是钉子，基本没变。 逐项分析 [A] 经历很多改进 → 与 haven't changed much 相反； [B] 自罗马时代基本没变 → 正确； [C] 研究少 → 无中生有； [D] 最重要发明之一 → 过度拔高。

entries.title: Which of the following best summarises the last two paragraphs?
entries.text: Which of the following best summarises the last two paragraphs? [A] Cheap technologies bring about revolutionary change. [B] Technological innovation is integral to economic success. 技术创新对经济成功不可或缺。 [C] Technology defines people's understanding of the world. 技术定义了人们对世界的理解。 [D] Sophisticated technologies develop from small inventions. 精妙的技术源于小发明。 答案 A Which of the following best summarises the last two paragraphs?以下哪项最能概括最后两段？ [A] Cheap technologies bring about revolutionary change. [B] Technological innovation is integral to economic success.技术创新对经济成功不可或缺。 [C] Technology defines people's understanding of the world.技术定义了人们对世界的理解。 [D] Sophisticated technologies develop from small inventions.精妙的技术源于小发明。 💡 考场思路倒数第二段末句是全文论点："it's the cheap technologies that change the world"——廉价技术改变世界。最后一段用古腾堡印刷机和太阳能板举例。 逐项分析 [A] 廉价技术带来革命性变化 → 正确，必须同时包含 cheap + change the world； [B] 技术创新对经济成功不可或缺 → 偏离； [C] 技术定义世界观 → 无中生有； [D] 复杂技术从小发明发展 → 与文意相反。 核心词汇 hype n. 大肆宣传 enchantingly adv. 迷人地 be poised to 准备就绪 niche uses 小众用途

entries.title: According to the first two paragraphs, alloparenting refers to the practice of _
entries.text: According to the first two paragraphs, alloparenting refers to the practice of ___. [A] sharing child care among community members [B] assigning babies to specific adult caregivers 将婴儿分配给特定的成人照料者 [C] teaching parenting details to older children 向大孩子讲授育儿细节 [D] carrying infants around by their parents 由父母随身抱着婴儿 答案 A According to the first two paragraphs, alloparenting refers to the practice of ___.根据前两段，异教育是指___的做法。 [A] sharing child care among community members [B] assigning babies to specific adult caregivers将婴儿分配给特定的成人照料者 [C] teaching parenting details to older children向大孩子讲授育儿细节 [D] carrying infants around by their parents由父母随身抱着婴儿 💡 考场思路alloparenting 出现在第二段，但定义在第一段：each child is cared for by many adults——每个孩子由很多成年人共同照料。 逐项分析 [A] 社区成员共同分担育儿 → 正确； [B] 指定给特定成年人 → 与 many adults 矛盾； [C] 教大孩子育儿 → 片面； [D] 父母背婴儿 → 这是 baby-wearing，不是 alloparenting。

entries.title: The scheme in Germany is mentioned to illustrate ___.
entries.text: The scheme in Germany is mentioned to illustrate ___. [A] an attempt to facilitate intergenerational communication 一次促进代际沟通的努力 [B] an approach to integrating alloparenting into western society [C] the conventional parenting style in western culture 西方文化中的传统育儿方式 [D] the differences between western and African ways of living 西方与非洲生活方式的差异 答案 B The scheme in Germany is mentioned to illustrate ___.提到德国的方案是为了说明___。 [A] an attempt to facilitate intergenerational communication一次促进代际沟通的努力 [B] an approach to integrating alloparenting into western society [C] the conventional parenting style in western culture西方文化中的传统育儿方式 [D] the differences between western and African ways of living西方与非洲生活方式的差异 💡 考场思路第三段论点句："there are ways to incorporate them into western life"——有办法把共同育儿融入西方生活。德国案例就是例子。 逐项分析 [A] 促进代际交流 → 这是案例表面内容； [B] 将共同育儿融入西方社会的方法 → 正确； [C] 西方传统育儿方式 → 与原文相反，这是新尝试； [D] 西方与非洲生活方式差异 → 不是为了对比。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 4, the "intensive mothering narrative" ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 4, the "intensive mothering narrative" ___. [A] alleviates parenting pressures 缓解育儿压力。 [B] considers family relationships 考量家庭关系 [C] results in the child-centered family 导致了以孩子为中心的家庭 [D] departs from the course of evolution 答案 D According to Paragraph 4, the "intensive mothering narrative" ___.根据第4段， “密集的育儿叙事” ___。 [A] alleviates parenting pressures缓解育儿压力。 [B] considers family relationships考量家庭关系 [C] results in the child-centered family导致了以孩子为中心的家庭 [D] departs from the course of evolution 💡 考场思路第四段说西方核心家庭"broke with evolutionary history"——打破进化史，即偏离进化进程。 逐项分析 [A] 缓解育儿压力 → 与 maternal exhaustion 相反； [B] 考虑家庭关系 → 无中生有； [C] 导致以孩子为中心 → 未提及； [D] 偏离进化进程 → 正确，broke with evolutionary history。

entries.title: What can be inferred from the nurseries in the UK?
entries.text: What can be inferred from the nurseries in the UK? [A] They tend to fall short of official requirements. 它们往往达不到官方要求。 [B] They have difficulty finding enough caregivers. 他们难以找到足够的照料者。 [C] They ought to improve their carer-to-child ratio. [D] They should try to prevent parental depression. 它们应努力预防父母抑郁。 答案 C What can be inferred from the nurseries in the UK?从英国的托儿所可以推断出什么？ [A] They tend to fall short of official requirements.它们往往达不到官方要求。 [B] They have difficulty finding enough caregivers.他们难以找到足够的照料者。 [C] They ought to improve their carer-to-child ratio. [D] They should try to prevent parental depression.它们应努力预防父母抑郁。 💡 考场思路英国托儿所1:4 vs 狩猎采集社会一个婴儿十几个照料者——对比暗示英国比例太低，应改善。

entries.title: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
entries.text: Which of the following would be the best title for the text? [A] Instructive teaching: a dilemma for anxious parents 启发式教学：焦虑父母的困境 [B] For a happier family, learn from the hunter-gatherers [C] Mixed-age playgroup, a better choice for lonely children 混龄游戏小组：孤独儿童更好的选择 [D] Tracing the history of parenting: from Africa to Europe 追溯育儿史：从非洲到欧洲 答案 B Which of the following would be the best title for the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] Instructive teaching: a dilemma for anxious parents启发式教学：焦虑父母的困境 [B] For a happier family, learn from the hunter-gatherers [C] Mixed-age playgroup, a better choice for lonely children混龄游戏小组：孤独儿童更好的选择 [D] Tracing the history of parenting: from Africa to Europe追溯育儿史：从非洲到欧洲 💡 考场思路全文首句即主旨：从非洲狩猎采集者那里获得的育儿秘诀可能是养出更快乐孩子的关键。

entries.title: What can be learned about Rutkowski from the first two paragraphs?
entries.text: What can be learned about Rutkowski from the first two paragraphs? [A] He is enthusiastic about using AI models. 他热衷于使用AI模型。 [B] He is popular with users of an AI art generator. [C] He attracts admiration from other illustrators. 他吸引了其他插画师的钦佩。 [D] He specializes in classical painting digitalization. 他专攻古典绘画的数字化。 答案 B What can be learned about Rutkowski from the first two paragraphs?从前两段中可以学到什么关于Rutkowski的信息？ [A] He is enthusiastic about using AI models.他热衷于使用AI模型。 [B] He is popular with users of an AI art generator. [C] He attracts admiration from other illustrators.他吸引了其他插画师的钦佩。 [D] He specializes in classical painting digitalization.他专攻古典绘画的数字化。 💡 考场思路第二段说他的风格是Stable Diffusion最常用提示词之一，说明他在AI生成器用户中很受欢迎。 逐项分析 [A] 他热衷于用AI → 后文说他concerning，态度转变； [B] 在AI艺术生成器用户中受欢迎 → 正确； [C] 受其他画家钦佩 → 未提及； [D] 专注古典绘画数字化 → 偷换，他uses classical painting styles。

entries.title: The problem with open-source AI art generators is that they ___.
entries.text: The problem with open-source AI art generators is that they ___. [A] lack flexibility in responding to prompts 在应对提示时缺乏灵活性 [B] produce artworks in unpredictable styles 以不可预测的风格创作艺术品 [C] make unauthorized use of online images [D] collect user information without consent 在未经同意的情况下收集用户信息 答案 C The problem with open-source AI art generators is that they ___.开源AI艺术生成器的问题在于它们___。 [A] lack flexibility in responding to prompts在应对提示时缺乏灵活性 [B] produce artworks in unpredictable styles以不可预测的风格创作艺术品 [C] make unauthorized use of online images [D] collect user information without consent在未经同意的情况下收集用户信息 💡 考场思路第三段直接说"built by scraping images from the Internet, without artist consent"——未经同意抓取网络图片。

entries.title: After searching online, Rutkowski found ___.
entries.text: After searching online, Rutkowski found ___. [A] a unique way to reach audiences 一种触达受众的独特方式 [B] a new method to identify AI images 一种识别AI图像的新方法 [C] AI-generated work bearing his name [D] heated disputes regarding his copyright 关于他版权的激烈争端 答案 C After searching online, Rutkowski found ___.在网上搜索后， Rutkowski找到了___。 [A] a unique way to reach audiences一种触达受众的独特方式 [B] a new method to identify AI images一种识别AI图像的新方法 [C] AI-generated work bearing his name [D] heated disputes regarding his copyright关于他版权的激烈争端 💡 考场思路第四段末：搜出来的作品"had his name attached to it but it wasn't his"——署着他名字的AI作品。

entries.title: According to Ortiz, AI companies are advised to ___.
entries.text: According to Ortiz, AI companies are advised to ___. [A] campaign for new policies or regulations 为新政策或新规发起运动 [B] offer their services to public institutions 向公共机构提供服务 [C] strengthen their relationships with AI users 加强与 AI 用户的关系 [D] adopt a different strategy for AI model training 答案 D According to Ortiz, AI companies are advised to ___.根据Ortiz的说法，建议人工智能公司___。 [A] campaign for new policies or regulations为新政策或新规发起运动 [B] offer their services to public institutions向公共机构提供服务 [C] strengthen their relationships with AI users加强与 AI 用户的关系 [D] adopt a different strategy for AI model training 💡 考场思路最后一段建议："AI models could be trained on images in the public domain"——用公共领域图片训练，即改变训练数据策略。

entries.title: What is the text mainly about?
entries.text: What is the text mainly about? [A] Artists' responses to AI art generation. [B] AI's expanded role in artistic creation. AI在艺术创作中角色的扩展。 [C] Privacy issues in the application of AI. AI应用中的隐私问题。 [D] Opposing views on AI development. 关于 AI 发展的对立观点。 答案 A What is the text mainly about?文字主要是关于什么的？ [A] Artists' responses to AI art generation. [B] AI's expanded role in artistic creation.AI在艺术创作中角色的扩展。 [C] Privacy issues in the application of AI.AI应用中的隐私问题。 [D] Opposing views on AI development.关于 AI 发展的对立观点。 💡 考场思路全文以两位艺术家为线索，讲AI生成艺术兴起后艺术家们从惊讶到担忧到维权的反应。

entries.title: The Chesapeake Bay is described in Paragraph 1 as ___.
entries.text: The Chesapeake Bay is described in Paragraph 1 as ___. [A] a valuable natural environment [B] a controversial conservation area 一个有争议的保护区 [C] a place with commercial potential 一个有商业潜力的地方 [D] a headache for nearby communities 邻近社区的头疼事 答案 A The Chesapeake Bay is described in Paragraph 1 as ___.切萨皮克湾在第1段中被描述为___。 [A] a valuable natural environment [B] a controversial conservation area一个有争议的保护区 [C] a place with commercial potential一个有商业潜力的地方 [D] a headache for nearby communities邻近社区的头疼事 💡 考场思路第一段全在讲切萨皮克湾的生态价值：栖息地、储洪水、过滤污染物、保护社区。

entries.title: The U.S. Supreme Court's ruling in the Idaho case ___.
entries.text: The U.S. Supreme Court's ruling in the Idaho case ___. [A] reinforces water pollution control 强化了水污染管控。 [B] weakens the EPA's regulatory power [C] will end conflicts among local residents 将终结当地居民之间的冲突 [D] may face opposition from mining operators 可能遭到采矿经营者的反对 答案 B The U.S. Supreme Court's ruling in the Idaho case ___.美国最高法院在爱达荷州案中的裁决___。 [A] reinforces water pollution control强化了水污染管控。 [B] weakens the EPA's regulatory power [C] will end conflicts among local residents将终结当地居民之间的冲突 [D] may face opposition from mining operators可能遭到采矿经营者的反对 💡 考场思路第二段首句"provides the EPA far less authority to regulate wetlands"——EPA权限大减。

entries.title: How does the author feel about the future of the Chesapeake Bay?
entries.text: How does the author feel about the future of the Chesapeake Bay? [A] Worried. [B] Puzzled. 困惑的。 [C] Relieved. 宽慰的；放心的。 [D] Encouraged. 受到鼓舞的。 答案 A How does the author feel about the future of the Chesapeake Bay?作者如何看待切萨皮克湾的未来？ [A] Worried. [B] Puzzled.困惑的。 [C] Relieved.宽慰的；放心的。 [D] Encouraged.受到鼓舞的。 💡 考场思路全文用了 put at great risk、shortsighted、dire consequences 等负面词，作者态度是担忧。

entries.title: What can be inferred about the EPA's involvement in the Chesapeake Bay Program?
entries.text: What can be inferred about the EPA's involvement in the Chesapeake Bay Program? [A] It has restored the balance among neighboring jurisdictions. 它恢复了相邻司法管辖区之间的平衡。 [B] It has triggered a radical reform in commercial fisheries. 它引发了商业渔业的彻底改革。 [C] It has set a fine example of respecting state authorities. 它树立了尊重州权的良好榜样。 [D] It has ensured the coordination of protection efforts. 答案 D What can be inferred about the EPA's involvement in the Chesapeake Bay Program?关于美国环保署参与切萨皮克湾计划，可以推断出什么？ [A] It has restored the balance among neighboring jurisdictions.它恢复了相邻司法管辖区之间的平衡。 [B] It has triggered a radical reform in commercial fisheries.它引发了商业渔业的彻底改革。 [C] It has set a fine example of respecting state authorities.它树立了尊重州权的良好榜样。 [D] It has ensured the coordination of protection efforts. 💡 考场思路第四段说EPA参与"transcend the influence of deep-pocketed special interests"——超越各州利益，即跨州协调保护。

entries.title: The author holds that the state lawmakers should ___.
entries.text: The author holds that the state lawmakers should ___. [A] be cautious about the influence of landowners 对地主的影响力保持谨慎 [B] attach due importance to wetlands protections [C] recognize the need to expand wildlife refuges 认识到扩大野生动物保护区的必要 [D] improve the wellbeing of endangered species 改善濒危物种的福祉 答案 B The author holds that the state lawmakers should ___.提交人认为，州议员应该___。 [A] be cautious about the influence of landowners对地主的影响力保持谨慎 [B] attach due importance to wetlands protections [C] recognize the need to expand wildlife refuges认识到扩大野生动物保护区的必要 [D] improve the wellbeing of endangered species改善濒危物种的福祉 💡 考场思路最后一段"call on state lawmakers... to consider reviewing their own wetlands protections"——呼吁议员重视湿地保护。

entries.title: They sometimes travel more than sixty miles to find food or water, and are very
entries.text: They sometimes travel more than sixty miles to find food or water, and are very good at working out where other elephants are—even when they are out of sight. They sometimes travel more than sixty miles to find food or water, and are very good at working out where other elephants are—even when they are out of sight. 它们有时跋涉六十多英里寻找食物或水，并且非常善于判断其他大象的位置——即使那些大象不在视线范围内。 采分点① travel more than sixty miles 跋涉六十多英里；② work out 判断/弄清楚；③ out of sight 视线之外。

entries.title: The researchers are convinced that the elephants always know precisely where the
entries.text: The researchers are convinced that the elephants always know precisely where they are in relation to all the resources they need, and can therefore take shortcuts, as well as following familiar routes. The researchers are convinced that the elephants always know precisely where they are in relation to all the resources they need, and can therefore take shortcuts, as well as following familiar routes. 研究人员确信，大象总是准确知道自己相对于所需全部资源的位置，因此既能走捷径，也能循着熟悉的路线行进。 采分点① be convinced that 确信；② in relation to 相对于；③ take shortcuts 走捷径。

entries.text: One possibility was that they merely used their eyes and tried out the plants they found, but that would probably result in a lot of wasted time and energy, not least because their eyesight is actually not very good. One possibility was that they merely used their eyes and tried out the plants they found, but that would probably result in a lot of wasted time and energy, not least because their eyesight is actually not very good. 一种可能是，它们仅仅依靠视觉并尝试所发现的植物，但这很可能浪费大量时间和精力，尤其是因为它们的视力实际上并不好。 采分点① try out 尝试；② not least because 尤其是因为（高频考点）；③ eyesight 视力。

entries.title: The volatile chemicals produced by plants can be carried a long way, and they ar
entries.text: The volatile chemicals produced by plants can be carried a long way, and they are very characteristic: each plant or tree has its own particular odor signature. The volatile chemicals produced by plants can be carried a long way, and they are very characteristic: each plant or tree has its own particular odor signature. 植物产生的挥发性化学物质可以传播很远，而且具有特异性：每一种植物或树木都有自己独特的气味标识。 采分点① volatile chemicals 挥发性化学物质；② characteristic 特异的；③ odor signature 气味标识。

entries.title: The experiment showed that elephants may well use smell to identify patches of t
entries.text: The experiment showed that elephants may well use smell to identify patches of trees that are good to eat, and secondly to assess the quality of the trees within each patch. The experiment showed that elephants may well use smell to identify patches of trees that are good to eat, and secondly to assess the quality of the trees within each patch. 实验表明，大象很可能利用嗅觉来识别哪些树林值得取食，其次还能评估每片树林中树木的质量。 采分点① may well 很可能；② patches of trees 成片树林；③ assess 评估。

entries.title: Your international student friend Paul is going to give an oral report on ancien
entries.text: Your international student friend Paul is going to give an oral report on ancient Chinese scientists but does not know how to prepare it. Write an email to offer him some help. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. Part A 小作文（10分）— 建议信 原题指令 Directions Your international student friend Paul is going to give an oral report on ancient Chinese scientists but does not know how to prepare it. Write an email to offer him some help. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. 【译文】你的留学生朋友保罗准备做一个关于中国古代科学家的口头报告，却不知如何准备。写一封电子邮件为他提供帮助。字数约100词。邮件末尾不要署自己的名字，使用“李明”代替。 题目 国际学生Paul要做关于中国古代科学家的口头报告，不知如何准备，写邮件求助。约100词，落款Li Ming。 审题 ① 格式：邮件；② 语气：友好乐于助人；③ 内容：2-3条具体建议。 参考范文 Dear Paul, I was delighted to receive your email and would like to offer some practical advice on preparing your oral report on an ancient Chinese scientist. First, I suggest you choose Bi Sheng, the inventor of movable-type printing, whose story is both landmark and compelling. Second, consult authoritative sources such as Joseph Needham's works, which are reliable and accessible. Finally, rehearse your presentation in front of a mirror or record yourself, so you can polish both your content and delivery. I hope these suggestions help. Wish you a brilliant performance! Yours sincerely, L

entries.text: Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following chart. In your essay, you should 1) describe the chart briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The illustration, together with its chart, presents a thought-provoking phenomenon: people are increasingly turning to digital means for daily learning and entertainment, while the chart shows a steady rise in the proportion of citizens using online platforms over the past decade. Part B 大作文（20分）— 图表作文 原题指令 Directions Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following chart. In your essay, you should 1) describe the chart briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The illustration, together with its chart, presents a thought-provoking phenomenon: people are increasingly turning to digital means for daily learning and entertainment, while the chart shows a steady rise in the proportion of citizens using online platforms over the past decade. 【译文】根据下面的chart写一篇160–200词的短文。文中应： 1）简要描述chart；2）说明其寓意；3）给出你的评论。 请在答题卡2上 审题框架 三段式：①简要描述图画+图表；②阐释含义；③给出评论。160-200词。 参考范文 The vivid illustration and its accompanying chart jointly present a thought-provoking phenomenon. As the picture shows, people are increasingly turning to digital means for daily learning and entertainment, while the chart reveals a steady rise in the proportion of citizens using online platforms over the past decade. The implied message is that technology is reshaping our habits more deeply than we realize. Several factors account for this trend.
